label: sdc02_0252_sister_01
text: Whoa, this place is insane! It reminds me of the\nCrystal Pool![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0252_bbteacher_01
text: This is the Zero Lab, I take it? The structure’s\nexterior matches Geeta’s description, at least.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0252_brother_01
text: So this is the deepest point in Area Zero?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0252_select_01
text: Right!

label: sdc02_0252_select_02
text: Nope!

label: sdc02_0252_bbteacher_02
text: Well, yes and no.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0252_bbteacher_03
text: This is the deepest point that the Area Zero\nExpedition managed to reach long ago.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0252_bbteacher_04
text: You know, I’ve been told that the lowest level of\nthis laboratory contains a mysterious room whose\r\npurpose is entirely unknown.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0252_bbteacher_05
text: However, where I want to go is even deeper\nthan that...[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0252_sister_02
text: Sooo, you’re saying we should head\ninside this...“Zero Lab”?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0252_brother_02
text: Gate’s closed, though.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0252_sister_03
text: Huh? Oh, you’re right.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0252_sister_04
text:

text: We need to use the panel!

label: sdc02_0252_brother_03
text: Wowzers, this feels like a spy movie or\nsomethin’... Way cool...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

text: What? I didn’t say anything.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

text: Well then, can we count on you to unlock the\ngate, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

text: The “Zero Lab,” huh... If it were up to me,\nI would’ve named this place the “Crystal Lab.”[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

text: Wow, that panel disables the lock on the gate,\nhuh?\c\nI mean, uh...whatever.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
